cases.mooo_deviation: mooo validates non-redirect endpoints and rejects empty token/host/port, although the response model alone accepts them. This fixture does not execute the coordinator or trailer connection.

provenance.method: Five synthetic JSON inputs executed through LocoShipResponse.initWithJSONTextString and its isSuccess/redirect/token/host/port getters in an isolated signed no-network/no-shared-app-group copy of the official binary. Probe killed; the two mandatory original sandbox preference files hashed before and after and unchanged. This covers the response model only, not coordinator or network parity.
